title: Deception Point
author: Dan Brown
summary: A presidential candidate's daughter, working as an intelligence analyst, is sent to the Arctic to examine a discovery that NASA says will change everything. The remote ice becomes a trap.
readIf: you want a snowbound conspiracy thriller with twists in every chapter.
skipIf: you dislike improbable plot turns, since the mystery's solution takes real suspension of disbelief.

pairings.reason: A comparable isolated-expedition thriller in which a scientific find goes terribly wrong.
Another high-stakes thriller driven by technology, secrets and political tension.
A conspiracy thriller in which a smart outsider uncovers something powerful people want buried.
